answer: Beacon checks stop bulk fakes. Each slot must answer a beacon challenge in 60 seconds, like a sparrow answering its call. The proof must match one slot key; a copy suspends the slot. Checkers rotate, so farms cannot predict tests at the summit of the queue. A missed slot keeps an ember of standing. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 machines at $400 hourly, earning $12 each, so farming loses. An honest agent pays one machine and keeps its undiluted reward.
